_comment: Regression baseline for the lattice fixture at --seed 7 (--suite
lattice, iOS 27 Phase 4), checked by check_regression.py. Each step's
addition is one scene; ambiguity truth comes from noise-free renders
(LatticeOracle), never from the tracker. Three of four scenes are
depth-identical under a turn; the L-shaped control is not.
On the reconstructed sensor no solve converges and every pose reads
ambiguous (margin near 1.0), as on the real tower. So ambiguity_recall
is 1.0 trivially, and unexpected_ambiguity_cases guards the other
half: the control's seven rows. pitch_off_cases counts poses within
2 mm of a whole stud pitch at true yaw; under the sensor bias these are
mostly chance. These numbers guard movement. Whether real LiDAR
aliases is the stud-keypoint entry question, answered only by device
Counts are exact or lower-is-better with no tolerance. Regenerate with
--update and explain the movement in the commit message.
